content:
The offense of stalking, harassment, or threatening a person is punishable by imprisonment of up to three years or a fine under **Article 107a of the Swiss Criminal Code (StGB)**, which has been in force since **January 1, 2007**.

This article criminalizes **stalking (Stalking)** as a distinct offense, where a person repeatedly and intentionally follows, contacts, or otherwise harasses another person, creating fear or distress, and aims to violate their personal sphere or freedom. The introduction of this article was part of reforms to better protect victims of persistent harassment and stalking behaviors.
